rationale: IEC 60076-7 exponential top-oil/hot-spot model walked over the four load steps starting from initial top-oil rise 41.3 K. Per-step steady-state rise = 55*((1+5K^2)/6)^0.8, approached with oil time constant 3 h; hot-spot = top-oil + 23*K^1.3; relative ageing rate = 2^((hot-spot-98)/6). Total equivalent ageing = sum(rate*duration) = 7.0321 h; peak hot-spot 104.65 C < 120 C, so the cycle is admissible.
